body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Siena, Italy. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 3 km. It starts at Cathedral of Siena, Via di Città, 48, Siena, SI, Italy. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Cathedral of Siena. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Alexandra as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Embark on an adventure through Siena with an in-app audio guide, a perfect fit for enthusiasts of art, history, and Gothic architecture. Ticket admission to the iconic Cathedral of Siena is included, allowing immediate immersion into the grandeur of Siena’s religious and artistic heritage.
>
> (!) Please note that while your ticket to the cathedral is included and available within the app, the audio guide inside the cathedral is provided via a separate app.
>
> After you finish exploring the cathedral, set off on a journey through the cobblestone streets of Siena. You will visit the iconic Piazza del Campo, famous for its distinctive shell shape and historical significance, through the echoes of the past at Palazzo Salimbeni, Accademia Musicale Chigiana and more. The tour concludes at the imposing Medici Fortress, once a bastion of power and now a cultural landmark.
>
> En route, participants will indulge in sensorial stories of profound fountains, esteemed Renaissance painters, and a globally revered academy.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.00. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 252 ratings and 107 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
